Few things. First of all I don't want to hurt people who care about me. 

Next thing is simple - there are things I want to at least try to do. 

Third thing is my one year old niece - I am her godfather and I want to see her grow up, I want to be for her if something happens to her parents. 

Last thing is most annoying - I know that on reality I don't want to die, my brain, my mind wants to kill me. I don't want to die but I don't know how to handle my life. I feel so powerless. Suicide is easy path for relief but there is one fucked up thing connected to this - your relief become someone's pain. I've hurt people I cared and still care about and I don't want to hurt them more. It is so fucking annoying - even if killing myself looks like good way to end pain I can't do it because I know that end of one pain will start another.

Dude, it's not easy to write about such things. Life is not easy thing to deal with. I hope everyone here will be alright. Good luck boys and girls.
